sourceAccess: 已抓取原文核对:Wikipedia Honey / Trophallaxis / Royal jelly / Beeswax / Bumblebee / Bombus terrestris / Mason bee / Megachile / Monofloral honey / Queen bee / Trifolium repens、德文维基 Raps 与 Gewöhnliche Robinie、中文维基 刺槐、Die Honigmacher(Raps)、PMC 向日葵营养综述(PMC12078318)、McGregor 1976 苜蓿章;不可达:Britannica Honey(HTTP 403)与 Snodgrass《Anatomy of the Honey Bee》(无 URL),两者按已知知识核对;未抓取(相应断言已由其他所引来源覆盖):pfaf-lavandula、kozuharova-2022-lavender、mnwild-white-clover、mnwild-alfalfa、cnhnb-blueberry。

issues.claim: 吸取花蜜——蜂蜜的唯一原料
issues.problem: 所引 Wikipedia "Honey" 明确蜂蜜原料除花蜜外还有蜜露(honeydew,蚜虫等昆虫的分泌物),"唯一原料"与来源相抵
issues.suggestion: 改为"最主要原料",或加注"另有以蜜露为原料的蜜露蜜,本馆不展开"

issues.claim: 油菜的花蜜几乎所有蜂都够得着,薰衣草则要看喙的长短
issues.problem: 本条所引两个来源(Wikipedia Honey、Britannica Honey)均不涉及油菜/薰衣草花蜜的可及性;该断言在 sources 数组中另有支持来源(src-balfour-2013-lavender)但未被本条引用
issues.suggestion: 为本条补引 src-balfour-2013-lavender(及花朵馆相应来源),或改写为不点名具体花种的泛述

checkedClaims.claim: 花蜜是花朵分泌的含糖液体,主要成分是蔗糖、葡萄糖、果糖和水;含糖比例随花种差别很大
checkedClaims.result: 支持:花蜜含水与糖类构成与来源一致;糖浓度随花种变化为植物学常识
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: "Nectar from the flower generally has a water content of 70 to 80%";酶将"complex sugars like sucrose"水解为 glucose 与 fructose(蕴含花蜜含蔗糖及单糖)

checkedClaims.claim: 外勤蜂一趟连续拜访许多朵花,直到蜜胃装满才回巢
checkedClaims.result: 支持:蜜胃容量小,需多花才能装满
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: "In Apis mellifera, the honey stomach holds about 40 mg of liquid";采集流程描述与之一致

checkedClaims.claim: 花蜜存进蜜胃——食道末端能胀大的储袋,也叫蜜囊,不进消化道
checkedClaims.result: 支持:crop/honey stomach 为前肠(食道末端)膨大,标准昆虫解剖学
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: "delivers the liquid to the bee's honey stomach or 'honey crop'";Snodgrass 来源不可达,按已知解剖学核对成立

checkedClaims.claim: 蜜胃与消化道之间有阀门隔开,采回的花蜜和蜂自己的食物互不相混;真正被吃掉的只有经阀门进入消化道的一小部分
checkedClaims.result: 支持:前胃(proventriculus)阀门隔开蜜胃与中肠,并调控少量进入消化道,为 Snodgrass 解剖学标准内容
checkedClaims.evidence: Snodgrass《Anatomy of the Honey Bee》来源不可达,按已知知识核对;与 Wikipedia Honey 的蜜胃描述不冲突

checkedClaims.claim: 归巢路上加工已经开始:蜜胃里的花蜜混入了蜂头部腺体分泌的酶
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: "Salivary enzymes and proteins from the bee's hypopharyngeal gland are secreted into the nectar once it is in the bee's honey stomach"(下咽腺位于头部)

checkedClaims.claim: 外勤蜂把蜜胃里的花蜜口对口吐给内勤蜂,这种传递叫交哺
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Trophallaxis: "the honey bee Apis mellifera is able to protrude their proboscis and sip nectar from the open mandibles of the donor bee";Wikipedia Honey 描述外勤蜂将花蜜转交内勤蜂(hive bees)

checkedClaims.claim: 内勤蜂反复把蜜滴吐出又吸回,在口器上摊成薄膜——既继续混入酶,也让水分开始蒸发
checkedClaims.result: 支持:来源描述为在上颚间反复形成液泡以促消化与浓缩,"摊成薄膜"为同一行为的通俗表述
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: "the hive bees regurgitate the nectar, repeatedly forming bubbles between their mandibles, speeding its digestion and concentration"

checkedClaims.claim: 一滴花蜜从进巢到入房,常常经过不止一只蜂的口
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: "These groups work in relay, with one bee subjecting the processed nectar to bubbling and then passing the refined liquid on to others"

checkedClaims.claim: 转化酶把花蜜里的蔗糖水解成葡萄糖和果糖——这是蜂蜜以单糖为主的原因
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: 头部腺体酶 "begin cleaving complex sugars like sucrose and starches into simpler sugars such as glucose and fructose";蜂蜜主要糖为果糖与葡萄糖

checkedClaims.claim: 葡萄糖氧化酶把部分葡萄糖转成葡萄糖酸,并产生微量过氧化氢
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: "The bees mix glucose oxidase with expelled nectar... creating two byproducts – gluconic acid and hydrogen peroxide"

checkedClaims.claim: 这两步让蜜变得偏酸、高渗,微生物难以存活——蜂蜜能长期保存,靠的是化学,不是防腐剂
checkedClaims.result: 支持:与来源的保存机制描述(酸性、低水活度/高渗、过氧化氢)一致
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey 保存与抗菌机制段落(葡萄糖酸致酸、高糖低水分抑菌)

issues.claim: "酿成"的含水量各资料口径略有出入(约 17%–20%)
issues.problem: 与所引来源不符:Wikipedia "Honey" 给出的最终含水量为 15.5%–18%("final water content of between 15.5% and 18%");Britannica 不可达,按已知知识其通行口径约 17%。"20%"是部分法规/标准(如 Codex)的水分上限,不是所引来源中"酿成"的口径
issues.suggestion: 改为"约 15.5%–18%(维基百科),多数资料在 17%–18% 左右";如要保留 20%,应说明它是法规上限并补引相应标准来源

checkedClaims.claim: 刚采回的花蜜一半以上是水
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: "Nectar from the flower generally has a water content of 70 to 80%"

checkedClaims.claim: 直接储存会发酵
checkedClaims.result: 支持:与来源中高含水蜜易发酵、封盖防吸潮的表述一致
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey 发酵与含水量相关段落;封盖 "prevents further evaporation" 及防污染

checkedClaims.claim: 工蜂把蜜液薄薄摊进巢房,再成群扇动翅膀通风让水分蒸发;一部分工蜂专职扇翅
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: "Coordinated wing beating moves air across the wet honey, drawing out water and heat"

checkedClaims.claim: 含水量降到大约五分之一以下,花蜜才算酿成了蜂蜜
checkedClaims.result: 支持:15.5%–18% 在"五分之一(20%)以下",正文措辞成立(问题只在 boundary 的具体区间)
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: "final water content of between 15.5% and 18%"

checkedClaims.claim: 蜜酿熟后,工蜂用腹部蜡腺分泌的蜂蜡把巢房口封平
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Beeswax: "secrete it from eight wax-producing mirror glands on the inner sides of the sternites... on abdominal segments 4 to 7";Wikipedia Honey: "The bees then cap the cells of finished honey with wax"

checkedClaims.claim: 封盖是"这格蜜已酿成"的标志,也是养蜂人判断取蜜时机的依据
checkedClaims.result: 支持:来源明确封盖发生在蜜酿成之后;"取蜜时机依据"为养蜂通行常识性表述,与来源不冲突
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: 封盖针对 "finished honey","seals them from contamination and prevents further evaporation"

checkedClaims.claim: 封盖之下的蜂蜜是蜂群的存粮,蜜蜂属靠它撑过没有花的冬天;这也是蜜蜂大量储蜜、而多数蜂不储蜜的原因
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: "bees stockpile honey to provide for themselves... as in overwintering";多数蜂不大量储蜜与 Mason bee 条目 "Solitary bees produce neither honey nor beeswax" 及 Bumblebee 条目一致

issues.problem: 所引来源均未支持:Wikipedia Monofloral honey 对油菜蜜风味的描述是花香/果香("A floral – fresh fruit (fruity) aroma, warm, medium intensity"),Die Honigmacher 与德文维基 Raps 均未描述味道
issues.suggestion: 删去,或改为来源支持的"花果香、味温和";若保留"微辛",补引明确描述油菜蜜微辛/十字花科气味的来源

issues.problem: 所引来源只说明结晶质地而非速度:德文维基 Raps 称其为 "fein und schmalzartig kandierend"(细腻、猪油状结晶),未言"极快";Monofloral honey 条目亦未给结晶速度
issues.suggestion: 改为"极易结晶,结晶细腻(猪油状)",或补引明确说明油菜蜜结晶迅速的来源

checkedClaims.claim: 白色至乳黄
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Monofloral honey(rapeseed/canola): "Light yellow, whitish or dull ivory when crystallized"

checkedClaims.claim: 春季大宗蜜种;中国与欧洲的油菜产区皆有出产
checkedClaims.result: 支持:德国资料明确其为春季大流蜜;中国油菜蜜为大宗蜜种属常识且与 sources 中 src-liu-2017-cerana-osr 主题一致
checkedClaims.evidence: Die Honigmacher: 花期 4 月底–6 月初、"typischen Massentracht in Deutschland";德文维基 Raps: "eine der wichtigsten und ergiebigsten Nektarquellen für Honigbienen",每公顷一季可产蜜至 494 kg

issues.problem: 所引德文维基称该蜜在德国以 "Akazienhonig"(阿卡西亚蜜/"洋槐蜜")为名出售,未支持欧洲"常称刺槐蜜";专名表述与来源相左
issues.suggestion: 改为"欧洲(德语区等以 'Akazienhonig/阿卡西亚蜜' 为名出售)",或删去括注只保留产区

checkedClaims.claim: 据德文维基百科引用的养蜂资料估算,一株成年树一个花季分泌的花蜜可供酿出接近 1 公斤蜂蜜
checkedClaims.result: 支持:来源给出每树每花季平均 0.66–1.44 kg,"接近 1 公斤"为合理概括,且条目已注明是估算并交代出处
checkedClaims.evidence: 德文维基 Gewöhnliche Robinie: 每树每花季蜜产量平均 "zwischen 0,66 und 1,44 Kilogramm"

checkedClaims.claim: 市售"槐花蜜"的槐花指洋槐(刺槐)而非国槐
checkedClaims.evidence: 中文维基 刺槐: "刺槐也是一种重要的蜜源植物";并明确"槐花"惯指洋槐花(刺槐花),"中国原产的国槐花一般不直接食用"

checkedClaims.claim: 分布:中国北方与美国东部
checkedClaims.evidence: 中文维基 刺槐: "原生於美國中東部及東部的树种,現已廣泛引種至亚洲、欧洲等地",并提及中国黄河、淮河流域分布

checkedClaims.claim: 浅黄
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Monofloral honey(sunflower): "Pale yellow"

checkedClaims.claim: 葡萄糖比例高
checkedClaims.evidence: PMC12078318(向日葵花资源综述): 向日葵蜜 "generally described as having high glucose content",葡萄糖 31.2–45.0%

checkedClaims.claim: 结晶快
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Monofloral honey: "Because sunflower honey crystallizes quickly, becoming soft and easy to spread, it is often consumed in its crystallized state"

checkedClaims.claim: 向日葵种植区的夏季蜜种
checkedClaims.result: 支持:向日葵为夏花作物、其种植区产单花蜜,与所引来源一致
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Monofloral honey 收录 sunflower honey;PMC12078318 以向日葵为蜜蜂重要蜜粉源展开

checkedClaims.claim: 产区有以"蓝莓蜜"为名的单花蜜
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Monofloral honey: "blueberry honey is taken from the tiny white flowers of the blueberry bush... Produced in New England and in Michigan"

checkedClaims.claim: 北美等蓝莓集中栽培区
checkedClaims.evidence: 同上:New England 与 Michigan 均在北美

checkedClaims.claim: 它的色泽与风味,本馆尚未找到足以展出的系统资料
checkedClaims.result: 编辑口吻,不作事实断言核对;但提示:所引 Monofloral honey 条目其实给出了颜色("Light amber or amber")与风味描述,后续可据此补充
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Monofloral honey(blueberry)

checkedClaims.claim: 在北美、新西兰等牧场多的地方,"三叶草蜜"是最常见的单花蜜之一
checkedClaims.result: 支持:来源列出的主产国与所述地区吻合,并称白车轴草为世界许多地区的主要蜜源
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Monofloral honey(clover): 产地 "Canada, United States, Sweden and New Zealand";"a major nectar source in many parts of the world"

checkedClaims.claim: 它主要来自白车轴草等几种车轴草属牧草
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Monofloral honey: "White clover in particular is grown as a widespread blooming pasture crop and is a major nectar source in many parts of the world";Wikipedia Trifolium repens: 花"mostly visited by bumblebees and often by honey bees"

checkedClaims.claim: 色淡黄
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Monofloral honey(lavender): "Light yellow"

checkedClaims.claim: "薰衣草蜜"主产于地中海周边
checkedClaims.result: 支持:来源列出的主产国均为环地中海国家
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Monofloral honey: "Produced mainly in France, Italy and Spain"

issues.problem: 所引来源仅支持"白色"(Wikipedia Monofloral honey: "White");McGregor 1976 苜蓿章经全文检索无 white/amber/flavor 等颜色风味描述;"特浅琥珀色(extra light amber)"在本条所引来源中无依据
issues.suggestion: 改为"色极浅(白色)",或补引给出 "white to extra light amber" 口径的来源(如美国蜂蜜分级/National Honey Board 资料)

checkedClaims.claim: 味淡雅
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Monofloral honey(alfalfa): "Fine flavor – a subtle spicy profile and mildly scented floral aroma"

checkedClaims.claim: 在美国西部,紫花苜蓿是最重要的蜜源植物之一
checkedClaims.result: 支持:McGregor 详述苜蓿泌蜜量大、产优质蜜及战后美国西部大规模放蜂;"之一"的限定使断言成立
checkedClaims.evidence: McGregor 1976: "Alfalfa produces a large amount of nectar... from which honey bees produce excellent crops of high quality honey";1950 年代起加州等西部苜蓿田年租放数十万群蜂

checkedClaims.claim: 哺育蜂头部腺体分泌的乳状食物
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Royal jelly: "It is secreted from the glands in the hypopharynx of nurse bees";"secreted from the glands in the heads of worker bees"

checkedClaims.claim: 所有蜜蜂幼虫头三天都吃它
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Royal jelly: "fed to all larvae in the colony, regardless of sex or caste";"After three days, the drone and worker larvae are no longer fed with royal jelly"

checkedClaims.claim: 被选作蜂王的幼虫整个幼虫期、以及成年蜂王的一生,都以它为食
checkedClaims.result: 支持:幼虫期部分来源明言;"成年蜂王一生"由 Royal jelly 条目定义句支持("nutrition of larvae and adult queens"),"一生"的时长表述略强于原文但与通行知识一致;Queen bee 条目给出蜂王寿命 2–7 年、由工蜂饲喂
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Royal jelly: "queen larvae continue to be fed this special substance throughout their development";"a honey bee secretion that is used in the nutrition of larvae and adult queens"

checkedClaims.claim: 它不是蜂蜜,也不是蜂蜜的原料或"浓缩版";蜂蜜来自花蜜的采集与加工,蜂王浆来自蜂自身的腺体分泌
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Royal jelly: 定义为蜂的腺体分泌物(secretion);Wikipedia Honey: 蜂蜜由花蜜采集加工而来——两者来源判然有别

issues.claim: (熊蜂)存量小、不封盖,也不像蜂蜜那样浓缩
issues.problem: "存量小"有来源支持,但"不封盖"与"不像蜂蜜那样浓缩"在所引 Wikipedia Bumblebee / Bombus terrestris 中均未提及;且所引 Wikipedia Honey 明言 "All non-parasitic bumblebees and stingless bees produce honey","不像蜂蜜那样浓缩"的表述与之存在张力,需要专门来源支撑
issues.suggestion: 保留来源支持的部分("存量小,只够几天");"不封盖/不如蜂蜜浓缩"补引专门来源(如 Goulson《Bumblebees》等熊蜂专著)后再上,否则删去这两个短语

checkedClaims.claim: 蜜蜂属:采集、酿造、封盖、储存,靠储蜜撑过没有花的冬天
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Honey: 采集—酶转化—扇风浓缩—蜡封盖流程;"bees stockpile honey... as in overwintering"

checkedClaims.claim: 熊蜂也会把花蜜存进巢里的蜡罐
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Bumblebee: 蜂蜡"used in the construction of honeypots... to line empty cocoons for use as storage containers";"Pollen-storing bumblebees keep pollen in separate wax pots"

checkedClaims.claim: 熊蜂存量小(只够几天)
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Bumblebee: "Unlike honeybees, bumblebees only store a few days' worth of food, so are much more vulnerable to food shortages"

checkedClaims.claim: 熊蜂蜂群一年一代,秋末解散,只有新蜂王越冬,不需要过冬存粮
checkedClaims.result: 支持:年生活史与只有新蜂王越冬均有来源;"不需要过冬存粮"是由此生活史得出的合理因果表述
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Bumblebee: "Nests in temperate regions last only for a single season and do not survive the winter",工蜂雄蜂秋末死亡、新蜂王滞育越冬;Wikipedia Bombus terrestris: 新蜂王掘 "hibernaculum" 越冬

checkedClaims.claim: 独居蜂(壁蜂、切叶蜂、木蜂)不酿蜜;雌蜂把花粉和花蜜揉成"蜂粮",放进巢室、产一枚卵、封上巢室,幼虫吃着这份口粮长大
checkedClaims.evidence: Wikipedia Mason bee: "Solitary bees produce neither honey nor beeswax";"a pollen/nectar provision mass... lays an egg on top of the mass. Then, she creates a partition";Wikipedia Megachile: "places an egg in each cell with a supply of food, generally pollen, sometimes mixed with nectar... builds a cap and walls off the cell";"The larva hatches from the egg and consumes the food supply"
